_doc: Fields each role reads, as clear paths: Message.field.field (a message by its clear name, then fields / a oneof by clear name, each step but the last going into the field's message type). Resolved per game build by pipeline/bindings.py into datapack/bindings.json (obfuscated names). Names the beta does not give are confirmed in work/overrides.json.

ah_buy._doc: ExchangeBidHouseBuyResultEvent (answer to an AH purchase): object_uid = uid of the lot bought (as in the AH listing), bought = success.

ah_row._doc: ExchangeBidHouseInListUpdatedEvent (a row of the open AH listing changed, e.g. after a purchase): same shape as an ah_item row (prices per stack size, three unordered ints uid / gid / type, effects).

ah_row_removed._doc: ExchangeBidHouseInListRemovedEvent (a row left the open AH listing): three unordered ints uid / gid / type.

avg_prices._doc: ObjectAveragePricesEvent: repeated entries of (item gid (the int32), two int64: the average per-unit price over the last week and an unused one, told apart by value).

inventory._doc: InventoryContentEvent (sent at login) -> objects (two lists of ObjectItemInventory, told apart by content) -> {item (two ObjectItem fields, told apart by content), position (0-15 equipped, 63 bag)} -> ObjectItem {three unordered ints gid / uid / quantity, effects: ObjectEffect}; ObjectAdded/ObjectsAdded/ObjectModified events carry ObjectItemInventory, ObjectDeleted/ObjectsDeleted object uids.

ah_type._doc: ExchangeTypesExchangerDescriptionForUserEvent (an AH category opened): gids = every item on sale in it, type = its item type.

ah_gone._doc: ExchangeBidHouseGenericItemRemovedEvent (the last lot of an item left the AH): gid.

ah_mine._doc: The player's own AH lots. ExchangeBidSellerStartedEvent (sell window opened): objects = ItemToSellInBid {item, sell_id (the int32, assumed to be the AH listing uid), prices = price + unsold delay (int64s, not told apart)}; ExchangeBidHouseItemAddedEvent (a lot put on sale): added_item + added_prices. The item: three unordered ints uid / quantity / gid (object uid, not the AH listing uid) + effects.

decraft._doc: DecraftResultEvent (breaking items into runes): results = DecraftedItem {coefs (two floats: coefficient of the first and the last item of the stack, 0.529 = 52.9 %; min / max told apart by value), uid (object uid of the broken item), runes: Rune {two ints: rune gid (a rune of the pack) and quantity, told apart by value}}.

fight._doc: Fighters (FightFighterShowEvent / FightFighterRefreshEvent information, FightSynchronizeEvent fighters, summons of GameActionFightEvent): ActorPositionInformation {actor_id, actor_information -> fighter -> ai_fighter -> MonsterFighter {three unordered ints monster_gid / creature_grade / creature_level}, stats: FightCharacteristics {summoned, summoner (actor id)}, spawn: SpawnInformation {alive, team, ...}}. Found by walking the message. death = GameActionFightEvent's Death member (two int64, target id + an unnamed one: the one that is a fighter of the fight died).

boost._doc: Fight buffs (confirmed on a capture). FightBoostAddEvent / FightJoinRunningEvent effects carry FightRemovableEffectExtendedInformation {effect: FightRemovableEffect {target_id (the int64), ints = its eight int32 (uid, spell, duration...: the uid is learnt, see combat.rs)}, action_id (= effects table id: 1131-1140 = PA / PM poisons), source_id}; FightBoostRemoveEvent {boost_uid (its only int32)} ends one. character = character_id of CharacterSelectionRequest / CharacterFirstSelectionRequest (client -> server at login: the player's own fighter id).

card._doc: Another player's card (click a player -> profile). CardViewRequest (client, named by anchor) {character, view}; CardInfoResponse -> info_success (Success) -> info (the character: two int64 = id (the one asked by the CardViewRequest) + another, name, three plain int32 = breed / level (Omega levels included) / another, told apart by value); CardViewResponse -> view_success (Success) -> equipment (EquipmentCard) {items: map worn position (0-15) -> preset.Equipment {gid, uid?, effects: ObjectEffect}, characteristics: CharacteristicsInfo}; or -> unauthorized (private equipment). Responses carry no character id: the CardViewRequest with the same envelope uid gives it.
